data.long_meaning: In the Italian language, the name Gasparo is derived from the elements 'gas', meaning 'treasure', and 'paros', meaning 'carrier'. This name was traditionally given to someone believed to be carrying a valuable treasure or burden. In Christian tradition, Gasparo is one of the Three Magi, also known as the Wise Men, who followed the star of Bethlehem to bring gifts to the newborn Jesus.
